calls.text: extreme close-up of rain on a cyberpunk window at night, neon reflections rippling on wet glass, droplets catching pink and cyan bokeh, cinematic
camera pulls back to a wide shot of a megacity skyline in heavy downpour, rain sheeting over towering cyberpunk towers, neon glow bleeding through the storm, cinematic
holographic neon signs flickering pink and cyan in the storm, glitching holograms over the rain-soaked cyberpunk street, rain streaks through the neon light, cinematic
the rain is easing, the cyberpunk city fades to a calm blue night, neon dimming, last drops sliding down wet glass, quiet blue tones, cinematic
